title: Dynamic Grid Management Reduces Wildfire Adaptation Costs in the Electric Power Sector
The Efficiency and Equity Impacts of Risk Classification in Catastrophe Insurance
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy

title: How Are Insurance Markets Adapting to Climate Change? Risk Selection and Regulation in the Market for Homeowners Insurance
Wildfire Insurance, Information, and Self-Protection
abstract: Like other climate-related disasters, wildfires are intensifying. Property owners can reduce their vulnerability to wildfire losses but are not well informed about the costs and benefits of available self-protection investments. Technological advances mean that insurers are increasingly able to monitor household mitigation behavior. We revisit the problem of self-protection from risk in a setting where households have incomplete insurance and limited information about self-protection investments. Insurer discounts for self-protection generate additional value by informing households about self-protection investments that also reduce uninsured losses. This information provision increases the responsiveness of self-protection to ex post disaster assistance, with implications for optimal government transfers.
abstract_zh: 与其他气候相关灾害一样，野火正在加剧。房产所有者可以降低其对野火损失的脆弱性，但对于可供选择的自我保护投资的成本与收益，他们了解得并不充分。技术进步意味着保险公司越来越能够监测家庭的减灾行为。我们在家庭保险不完全、且对自我保护投资信息有限的情形下，重新审视了风险自我保护问题。保险公司对自我保护的折扣，通过向家庭提供自我保护投资的信息，创造了额外价值，因为这些投资同样能减少未投保的损失。这种信息提供增强了自我保护行为对灾后事后援助的反应，并对最优政府转移支付具有启示意义。

title: How Does the US Price Carbon? How Could We Price Carbon?
Mitigating Emissions Leakage in Incomplete Carbon Markets
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Policies regulating greenhouse gas emissions apply to a small subset of emitting sources. This raises a formidable concern: emissions can “leak” from regulated to unregulated sources. We provide a theoretical basis for deriving industry-specific measures of leakage risk and for calibrating the output-based subsidies that are currently used to mitigate leakage. Using US energy price variation as a proxy for variation that would be induced by a domestic carbon price, we show how theoretically consistent leakage-mitigating subsidies can be calibrated. We simulate the impacts of a domestic carbon price on US manufacturing with and without these subsidies. Absent mitigation, emissions leakage is substantial. Output-based subsidies targeted on the basis of our leakage risk measures significantly reduce this leakage risk. In contrast, the current practice of coarsely targeting subsidies on the basis of emissions intensity and trade exposure delivers a small fraction of leakage mitigation benefits while incurring significant costs.
abstract_zh: 规制温室气体排放的政策只适用于一小部分排放源。这引发了一个严峻的担忧：排放可能从受规制的排放源“泄漏”到未受规制的排放源。我们为推导行业特定的泄漏风险指标，以及校准目前用于缓解泄漏的基于产出的补贴，提供了理论基础。我们以美国能源价格的变化作为国内碳价格所引致变化的代理变量，展示了如何校准理论上一致的泄漏缓解补贴。我们模拟了国内碳价格在有无这些补贴情况下对美国制造业的影响。若不采取缓解措施，排放泄漏是相当可观的。基于我们的泄漏风险指标有针对性地设计的基于产出的补贴，可显著降低这一泄漏风险。相比之下，目前以排放强度和贸易暴露程度为依据、较为粗略地确定补贴对象的做法，只能带来很小一部分的泄漏缓解收益，却要承担高昂的成本。

title: Border Carbon Adjustments When Carbon Intensity Varies Across Producers: Evidence from California
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: Governments taxing carbon emissions within their jurisdiction can impose a commensurate tax on emissions embodied in imports in order to mitigate emissions leakage. California offers a rare opportunity to investigate how such a border carbon adjustment (BCA) is working in practice. Experience to date highlights important tensions between greenhouse gas accounting accuracy, market efficiency, and concerns about trade protectionism. We simulate electricity market outcomes under BCA designs that differ in terms of how the carbon intensity of imports is assessed. Simulations suggest significant potential for leakage via resource shuffling. Realized emissions outcomes indicate that this potential has not been fully realized.
abstract_zh: 对其辖区内碳排放征税的政府，可以对进口产品所含的排放征收同等税负，以缓解排放泄漏。加利福尼亚州为考察这种边境碳调节（BCA）在实践中如何运作提供了难得的机会。迄今为止的经验突显了温室气体核算准确性、市场效率与贸易保护主义担忧之间的重要张力。我们模拟了在进口产品碳强度的评估方式不同的BCA设计下的电力市场结果。模拟结果表明，通过资源转移存在显著的泄漏可能性。而实际的排放结果显示，这一可能性并未完全实现。

title: Default Effects and Follow-on Behavior: Evidence from an Electricity Pricing Program
abstract: We study default effects in the context of a residential electricity pricing program. We implement a large-scale randomized controlled trial in which one treatment group is given the option to optin to time-based pricing while another is defaulted into the program but allowed to opt-out. We provide dramatic evidence of a default effect -a significantly higher fraction of households defaulted onto the time-based pricing plan enroll in the program, even though opting out simply involved making a phone call or clicking through to a website.A distinguishing feature of our empirical setting is that we observe follow-on behavior subsequent to the default manipulation. Specifically, we observe customers' electricity consumption in light of the pricing plan they face. This, in conjunction with randomization of the default provision, allows us to separately identify the electricity consumption response of "complacent" households (i.e., those who only enroll in time-based pricing if assigned to the opt-out treatment).We find that the complacent households do reduce electricity use during higher priced peak periods, though significantly less on average compared to customers who actively opt in. However, with complacents comprising approximately 75 percent of the population, we observe significantly larger average demand reductions among consumers assigned to the opt-out group. We examine the extent to which the behavioral responses we observe are consistent with a standard model of switching costs, or with alternative mechanisms including inattention, and preferences constructed based on contextual features of the choice setting.
abstract_zh: 我们在住宅电价计划的背景下研究默认选项效应。我们开展了一项大规模随机对照试验：一组处理组可以选择加入分时电价计划，另一组则被默认纳入该计划，但允许其选择退出。我们提供了显著的默认选项效应的有力证据——被默认纳入分时电价计划的家庭中，参加该计划的比例显著更高，尽管退出只需打一个电话或点击一个网站即可完成。我们实证设定的一个显著特点在于，我们能够观察到默认设置之后的后续行为。具体而言，我们观察了客户在其所面临的电价计划下的用电量。结合默认条款的随机分配，这使我们能够分别识别“自满型”家庭（即仅在被分配到退出组时才会加入分时电价计划的家庭）的用电响应。我们发现，自满型家庭确实会在电价较高的用电高峰时段减少用电，但平均而言，减少幅度明显小于主动选择加入的客户。然而，由于自满型家庭约占总人口的75%，我们观察到被分配到退出组的消费者的平均需求削减幅度明显更大。我们还考察了所观察到的行为反应在多大程度上与转换成本的标准模型相吻合，或与包括注意力不足在内的其他机制以及基于选择情境特征构建的偏好相一致。

title: The Economics of Energy Efficiency in Developing Countries
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Climate Policy, Environmental Justice, and Local Air Pollution
Co-Benefits and Regulatory Impact Analysis: Theory and Evidence from Federal Air Quality Regulations
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: This paper considers the treatment of co-benefits in benefit-cost analysis of federal air quality regulations. Using a comprehensive data set on all major Clean Air Act rules issued by the Environmental Protection Agency over the period 1997-2019, we show that (1) co-benefits make up a significant share of the monetized benefits; (2) among the categories of co-benefits, those associated with reductions in fine particulate matter are the most significant; and (3) co-benefits have been pivotal to the quantified net benefit calculation in exactly half of cases. Motivated by these trends, we develop a simple conceptual framework that illustrates a critical point: co-benefits are simply a semantic category of benefits that should be included in benefit-cost analyses. We also address common concerns about whether the inclusion of co-benefits is problematic because of alternative regulatory approaches that may be more cost-effective and the possibility for double counting.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨联邦空气质量法规效益—成本分析中对协同效益的处理。利用1997—2019年间美国环境保护署（EPA）发布的所有主要《清洁空气法》规则的综合数据集，我们表明：（1）协同效益在货币化效益中占据相当大的份额；（2）在各类协同效益中，与细颗粒物（PM2.5）减排相关的效益最为重要；（3）在恰好一半的情形中，协同效益对量化的净效益计算起到了关键作用。基于这些趋势，我们构建了一个简单的概念框架，阐明了一个关键观点：协同效益本质上只是效益的一种语义类别，理应纳入效益—成本分析。我们还讨论了一些常见的担忧，包括纳入协同效益是否会因存在成本效益更高的替代监管方式而出现问题，以及是否存在重复计算的可能性。

title: Deep Flaws in a Mercury Regulatory Analysis
Bringing Satellite-Based Air Quality Estimates Down to Earth
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We use state-of-the-art, satellite-based PM 2.5 data products to assess the extent to which the Environmental Protection Agency's existing, monitor-based measurements over- or underestimate true exposure to PM 2.5 pollution. Treating satellite-based estimates as truth implies a substantial number of “policy errors”--overregulating areas that are in compliance with the air quality standards and under-regulating other areas that appear to be in violation. We investigate the health implications of these apparent errors. We also highlight the importance of accounting for prediction error in satellite-based estimates. Once prediction errors are accounted for, conclusions with regards to “policy errors” become substantially more uncertain.
abstract_zh: 我们利用最先进的卫星PM 2.5数据产品，评估美国环境保护署现有的基于监测站的测量，在多大程度上高估或低估了真实的PM 2.5污染暴露。若将卫星估计视为真值，则会得出大量“政策错误”：对已符合空气质量标准的地区过度规制，而对看似违规的其他地区规制不足。我们考察了这些明显错误的健康含义。我们还强调了在卫星估计中考虑预测误差的重要性。一旦计入预测误差，关于“政策错误”的结论将变得显著更加不确定。

title: Market-based emissions regulation when damages vary across sources: What are the gains from differentiation?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Much of the air pollution currently regulated under U.S. emissions trading programs is non-uniformly mixed, meaning that health and environmental damages depend on the location and dispersion characteristics of the sources. Existing policy regimes ignore this fact. Emissions are penalized at a single permit price, regardless of the location of the source. In theory, differentiated policies can be designed to accommodate non-uniformly mixed pollution using emissions penalties that vary with emissions damages. Under perfect certainty, damage-based policy differentiation is unambiguously welfare improving. In the presence of uncertainty about damages and abatement costs, differentiated policies need not welfare dominate simpler, undifferentiated designs. Using rich data from a major U.S. emissions trading program, we estimate the welfare impacts of policy differentiation. Surprisingly, we find that differentiated emissions trading results in welfare loss as compared to the undifferentiated trading regime that was implemented. This result manifests because ex post realized abatement costs appear to have exceeded expectations. We further show that, in this context, a differentiated price-based policy welfare dominates the differentiated quantity-based alternative.
abstract_zh: 目前美国排放权交易计划所规制的大部分空气污染物并非均匀混合，这意味着健康和环境损害取决于排放源的位置和扩散特征。现行政策体制忽视了这一事实。无论排放源位于何处，排放都以统一的许可价格受到处罚。从理论上讲，可以设计差异化政策，采用随排放损害而变化的排放处罚，以适应非均匀混合的污染。在完全确定的情况下，基于损害的政策差异化无疑会改善福利。在损害和减排成本存在不确定性的情况下，差异化政策未必在福利上优于更简单的无差异化设计。利用美国一个大型排放权交易计划的丰富数据，我们估计了政策差异化的福利影响。令人惊讶的是，我们发现，与已实施的无差异化交易制度相比，差异化排放权交易导致了福利损失。出现这一结果的原因在于，事后实际实现的减排成本似乎超出了预期。我们进一步表明，在此背景下，差异化的价格型政策在福利上优于差异化的数量型替代方案。

title: Challenges in the Measurement of Leakage Risk
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings

title: Do Energy Efficiency Investments Deliver? Evidence from the Weatherization Assistance Program
abstract: A growing number of policies and programs aim to increase investment in energy efficiency, because conventional wisdom suggests that people fail to take-up these investments even though they have positive private returns and generate environmental benefits. Many explanations for this energy efficiency gap have been put forward but there has been surprisingly little field testing of whether the conventional wisdom is correct. This paper reports on the results of an experimental evaluation of the nation’s largest residential energy efficiency program – the Weatherization Assistance Program – conducted on a sample of approximately 30,000 households in Michigan. The findings suggest that the upfront investment costs are about twice the actual energy savings. Further, the model-projected savings are more than three times the actual savings. While this might be attributed to the “rebound” effect – when demand for energy end uses increases as a result of greater efficiency – the paper fails to find evidence of significantly higher indoor temperatures at weatherized homes. Even when accounting for the broader societal benefits derived from emissions reductions, the costs still substantially outweigh the benefits; the average rate of return is approximately -7.8% annually.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的政策和计划旨在增加节能投资，因为通行观点认为，尽管此类投资具有正的私人收益并能带来环境效益，人们却未能采纳。关于这种“能源效率缺口”，已经提出了许多解释，但令人惊讶的是，对于通行观点是否正确，实地检验却很少。本文报告了对全美规模最大的住宅节能计划——住房节能改造援助计划（Weatherization Assistance Program）——进行的实验评估结果，样本为密歇根州约30,000户家庭。研究结果表明，前期投资成本约为实际节能量的两倍。此外，模型预测的节能量是实际节能量的三倍多。虽然这可能归因于“反弹效应”——即能源效率提高后，能源终端用途的需求随之增加——但本文并未发现改造后住房室内温度显著升高的证据。即便考虑到减排所带来的更广泛的社会效益，成本仍大大超过收益；平均年收益率约为-7.8%。

title: Solar Microgrids and Remote Energy Access: How Weak Incentives Can Undermine Smart Technology
venue: Economics of Energy and Environmental Policy

title: Influence of Acceleration Tradeoffs on CO2 Emissions and Costs of Fuel Economy and Greenhouse Gas Regulations
Location, Location, Location: The Variable Value of Renewable Energy and Demand-side Efficiency Resources
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Greenhouse gas mitigation efforts in the electricity sector have emphasized accelerated deployment of energy efficiency (EE) measures and renewable energy (RE) resources. We evaluate renewable energy and energy efficiency technologies across regional power systems in the United States in terms of carbon dioxide emissions displaced, operating costs avoided, and capacity value generated. We use data on hourly emissions and electricity generation, simulated hourly production across thousands of wind and solar sites, wholesale electricity prices, and technology costs. We find that variation in the quantity of emissions displaced by wind, solar, and efficiency resources is significant across regions but limited across resources within a region. Comparing our estimates of emissions-related benefits against technology costs, we document substantial variation in the net cost per ton of CO2 avoided. This variation has not been reflected in the prevailing policy incentives that guide investments in RE and EE resources.
abstract_zh: 电力部门的温室气体减排努力，强调加快能效（EE）措施和可再生能源（RE）资源的部署。我们以所替代的二氧化碳排放量、所避免的运营成本以及所产生的容量价值为标准，评估了美国各区域电力系统中的可再生能源和能效技术。我们使用了逐时排放和发电数据、数千个风电和光伏场址的逐时模拟发电量、批发电价以及技术成本数据。我们发现，风能、太阳能和能效资源所替代的排放量在各地区之间差异显著，但在同一地区内各类资源之间差异有限。将我们对排放相关收益的估计与技术成本相比较，我们记录了每避免一吨二氧化碳的净成本存在显著差异。而这种差异并未体现在目前指导可再生能源和能效资源投资的主流政策激励之中。

title: Market-Based Emissions Regulation and Industry Dynamics
abstract: We assess the long-run dynamic implications of market-based regulation of carbon dioxide emissions in the US Portland cement industry. We consider several alternative policy designs, including mechanisms that use production subsidies to partially offset compliance costs and border tax adjustments to penalize emissions associated with foreign imports. Our results highlight two general countervailing market distortions. First, following Buchanan (1969), reductions in product market surplus and allocative inefficiencies due to market power in the domestic cement market counteract the social benefits of carbon abatement. Second, trade exposure to unregulated foreign competitors leads to emissions "leakage" which offsets domestic emissions reductions. Taken together, these forces result in social welfare losses under policy regimes that fully internalize the emissions externality. In contrast, market-based policies that incorporate design features to mitigate the exercise of market power and emissions leakage can deliver welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了以市场为基础的二氧化碳排放规制，对美国波特兰水泥行业长期动态的影响。我们考虑了几种替代性政策设计，包括利用生产补贴部分抵消合规成本的机制，以及对进口产品所含排放进行惩罚的边境税调整。我们的结果突显了两种普遍存在、方向相反的市场扭曲。第一，依据Buchanan（1969）的思路，国内水泥市场中的市场势力导致产品市场剩余减少和配置效率损失，抵消了减排的社会收益。第二，面对未受规制的境外竞争者所形成的贸易暴露，会导致排放“泄漏”，从而抵消国内的减排效果。综合来看，在充分内部化排放外部性的政策体制下，这些力量会导致社会福利损失。相比之下，若以市场为基础的政策纳入了能够缓解市场势力行使和排放泄漏的设计特征，则可以带来福利改善。

title: Reforming the Federal Coal Leasing Program
Are the Non-monetary Costs of Energy Efficiency Investments Large? Understanding Low Take-Up of a Free Energy Efficiency Program
venue: American Economic Review Papers and Proceedings
abstract: We document very low take-up of an energy efficiency program that is widely believed to be privately beneficial. Program participants receive a substantial home “weatherization” retrofit; all installation and equipment costs are covered by the program. Less than 1 percent of presumptively eligible households take up the program in the control group. This rate increased only modestly after we took extraordinary efforts to inform households—via multiple channels–about the sizable benefits and zero monetary costs. These findings are consistent with high non-monetary costs associated with program participation and/or energy efficiency investments.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了一项被普遍认为对私人有利的节能计划的极低参与率。参与者可以获得一次大规模的家庭“节能改造”，所有安装和设备成本均由该计划承担。在对照组中，不到1%的推定合格家庭参与了该计划。即便我们付出了特别的努力，通过多种渠道向家庭告知其巨大收益以及零货币成本，参与率也只是略有提高。这些发现与参与该计划和/或节能投资所伴随的高非货币成本相一致。

title: An Economic Perspective on the EPA’s Clean Power Plan
Distributing Pollution Rights in Cap-and-Trade Programs: Are Outcomes Independent of Allocation?
abstract: Standard economic theory predicts that if property rights to pollute are clearly established, equilibrium outcomes in an efficient emissions permit market will be independent of how the emissions permits are initially distributed. This so-called independence property has important implications for policy design and implementation. Past studies document a strong positive correlation between the initial permit allocation and firm-level emissions, raising concerns that the independence property is failing to hold in real-world settings. We exploit the random assignment of firms to different permit allocation cycles in Southern California's RECLAIM program in order to test the independence of permit allocation and emissions. Our results lend empirical support to the independence hypothesis.
abstract_zh: 标准经济理论预测，如果污染产权得到明确界定，那么在有效的排放许可市场中，均衡结果与排放许可的初始分配方式无关。这一所谓的独立性质，对政策设计和实施具有重要意义。以往研究记录了初始许可分配与企业层面排放之间存在强烈的正相关，这引发了人们对独立性质在现实世界中是否成立的担忧。我们利用南加州RECLAIM计划中企业被随机分配到不同许可分配周期这一特点，检验许可分配与排放之间的独立性。我们的结果为独立性假说提供了实证支持。

title: The Economics of Solar Energy
Sacred Cars? Cost‐Effective Regulation of Stationary and Non‐stationary Pollution Sources
Updating the Allocation of Greenhouse Gas Emissions Permits in a Federal Cap-and-Trade Program
venue: The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy (University of Chicago Press), book chapter
abstract: U.S. adoption of a cap-and-trade program for greenhouse gases could place some domestic producers at a disadvantage relative to international competitors who do not face similar regulation. To address this issue, proposed federal climate change legislation includes a provision that would freely allocate (or rebate) emission allowances to eligible sectors using a continuously updating output-based formula. Eligibility for the rebates would be determined at the industry-level based on emissions or energy intensity and a measure of import penetration. Dynamic updating of permit allocations has the potential to mitigate adverse competitiveness impacts and emissions leakage in eligible industries. It can also undermine the cost-effectiveness of permit market outcomes, as more of the mandated emissions reductions must then be achieved by sources deemed ineligible for rebates. This chapter investigates both the benefits and the costs of output-based updating. It identifies differences between proposed eligibility criteria and those consistent with standard measures of economic efficiency. The analysis underlines the importance of taking both ben fits and costs into account when determining the scale and scope of output-based rebating provisions in cap-and-trade programs.
abstract_zh: 美国若采用温室气体总量控制与交易计划，可能会使一些国内生产者相对于那些不受类似规制的国际竞争对手处于劣势。为解决这一问题，拟议中的联邦气候变化立法包含一项条款，即利用持续更新的基于产出的公式，向符合条件的部门免费分配（或返还）排放配额。获得返还资格将根据行业层面的排放或能源强度以及进口渗透率指标来确定。许可分配的动态更新，有可能减轻符合条件行业的不利竞争力影响和排放泄漏。但它也可能削弱许可市场结果的成本有效性，因为此时更多的强制减排必须由不具备返还资格的排放源来实现。本章考察了基于产出的更新机制的收益与成本。它指出了拟议的资格标准与符合标准经济效率衡量指标的资格标准之间的差异。分析强调，在确定总量控制与交易计划中基于产出的返还条款的规模和范围时，必须同时考虑收益和成本。

title: What Do Emissions Markets Deliver and to Whom? Evidence from Southern California's NOx Trading Program
abstract: A perceived advantage of cap-and-trade programs over more prescriptive environmental regulation is that enhanced compliance flexibility and cost effectiveness can make more stringent emissions reductions politically feasible. However, increased compliance flexibility can also result in an inequitable distribution of pollution. We investigate these issues in the context of Southern California's RECLAIM program. We match facilities in RECLAIM with similar California facilities also located in non-attainment areas. Our results indicate that emissions fell approximately 24 percent, on average, at RECLAIM facilities relative to our counterfactual. Furthermore, we find that observed changes in emissions do not vary significantly with neighborhood demographic characteristics.
abstract_zh: 与较为规范的环境规制相比，总量控制与交易计划的一个公认优势在于，增强的合规灵活性和成本有效性可以使更为严格的减排在政治上变得可行。然而，合规灵活性的提高也可能导致污染分布不公平。我们在南加州RECLAIM计划的背景下考察了这些问题。我们将RECLAIM中的企业与同样位于不达标地区的加州类似企业进行匹配。结果表明，相对于反事实情景，RECLAIM企业的排放平均下降了约24%。此外，我们发现观察到的排放变化并不随社区人口统计特征而产生显著差异。

title: Emissions Trading, Electricity Industry Restructuring, and Investment in Pollution Control
Incomplete Environmental Regulation, Imperfect Competition, and Emissions Leakage
abstract: Environmental regulation of industrial pollution is often incomplete; regulations apply to only a subset of facilities contributing to a pollution problem. Policymakers are increasingly concerned about the emissions leakage that may occur if unregulated production can be easily substituted for regulated production. This paper analyzes emissions leakage in an incompletely regulated and imperfectly competitive industry. The analytical model is used to simulate outcomes under incomplete, market-based regulation of carbon dioxide emissions in California's electricity sector. Regulation that exempts out-of-state producers achieves approximately one-third of the total emissions reductions achieved under complete regulation at more than twice the cost per ton. (JEL L94, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 工业污染的环境规制往往是不完全的：规制只适用于导致污染问题的部分设施。如果未受规制的生产能够轻易替代受规制的生产，政策制定者越来越担心可能发生的排放泄漏。本文分析了一个规制不完全且竞争不充分的行业中的排放泄漏。该分析模型用于模拟加利福尼亚州电力部门在不完全的、以市场为基础的二氧化碳排放规制下的结果。豁免州外生产者的规制，所实现的减排量约为完全规制下总减排量的三分之一，而每吨成本却超过完全规制的两倍。（JEL L94, Q53, Q58）

title: Demand Side Management and Energy Efficiency Revisited
abstract: The key finding of Loughran and Kulick (2004) is that utilities have been overstating electricity savings and underestimating costs associated with energy efficiency demand-side management (DSM) programs. This claim is based on point estimates of average DSM-related savings and costs implied by an econometric model of residential electricity demand. We first argue that the chosen test statistics bias results in favor of rejecting the null hypothesis that utility-reported savings reflect true values. We also note that utility estimates of average program savings and costs are rejected based on point estimates alone. We use the same data and econometric model to estimate the appropriate test statistics. We then construct nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals. These intervals are quite large; we fail to reject the average electricity savings and DSM costs reported by utilities. Our results suggest that the evidence for rejecting utility estimates of DSM savings and costs should be re-interpreted.
abstract_zh: Loughran和Kulick（2004）的主要发现是，公用事业公司高估了能效需求侧管理（DSM）项目的节电量，并低估了相关成本。这一结论基于一个居民电力需求计量模型所隐含的、DSM相关平均节电量和成本的点估计。我们首先指出，所选用的检验统计量存在偏误，使结果偏向于拒绝公用事业公司所报告的节电量反映真实值的原假设。我们还指出，仅凭点估计即否定公用事业公司对项目平均节电量和成本的估计，是不恰当的。我们使用相同的数据和计量模型，估计了恰当的检验统计量。随后，我们构造了非参数自助法（bootstrap）置信区间。这些置信区间相当宽，我们无法拒绝公用事业公司所报告的平均节电量和DSM成本。我们的结果表明，否定公用事业公司DSM节电量和成本估计的证据，应当重新加以解释。

title: Energy Efficiency in the Developing World
